reviews.text:
And just like that…From muddy and uninspired to expanding our living area in just 49 days!

I know that previous customers have raved about the timeliness, high quality workmanship and the attention to detail….

But for me (in addition to all that), it was the fact Dustin did exactly what he said he would do, plus things that I didn’t even know I needed that made this a stress free project, and is probably why the town inspector told me I made a great choice when he came by!!

Edge Outdoor Designs pays attention to the details, and treats the project as if it were their own backyard!
reviews.author: Ruth-Anne Calandra

reviews.text:
Edge Design exceeded every expectation we had for our backyard transformation. From start to finish, Dustin, Zack, Mica, and their entire team delivered an experience that was seamless, professional, and truly exceptional. The level of care, craftsmanship, and attention to detail was evident in every phase of the project.

They completed the entire build in under 60 days from dig to finish — an impressive timeline made even more remarkable by the fact that quality and design were never compromised. Communication was outstanding throughout. They took the time to walk us through every detail, responded quickly to questions, and consistently offered thoughtful solutions that made the process stress-free and enjoyable.

At completion, they thoroughly explained how everything worked and ensured every element was functioning perfectly before handing it over to us. The result is a backyard that far exceeds what we imagined — both in beauty and functionality.

If you are considering a backyard project, we cannot recommend Edge Design highly enough. They are truly in a league of their own.
reviews.author: Madeline McCants

reviews.text: We highly recommend Edge Outdoor Living! We had several quotes from several different companies, but Zack gave us the most confidence that they would get the job done the way we wanted and be done right. Plus be done in a timely manner. We knew we would be in good hands with Edge. Every morning/days they would give us updates. We were so happy with all the crew. They were great and all professional. Zack and Dustin were always quick to respond to our questions and concerns. They worked with us on the changes we made, and the pool came out exactly how we had hoped. Best of all is that they completed the project in less than 50 days, giving us plenty of summer to enjoy our new swimming pool. Thank you, Zack and Dustin, for an absolutely beautiful pool and backyard that our family will enjoy for many, many years. The memories will be endless. 😊
reviews.author: Elvira Perez

reviews.text: I wanted to share our wonderful experience with Edge Outdoor Designs!  Working with Zack during the design process, we knew right away that communication was going to be great and that things would move at a fast pace.  Work started on a Monday and by Thursday we already had a shotcrete shell!  This was completely amazing.  Zack and Dustin kept us informed throughout the process, communicated schedules to us, were always responsive,  confirmed all our selections, and the work continued to progress quickly.  The contractors were all professional.  The tile guys were artists.  They performed detailed cuts on the travertine and did a great job on the tile.  We had a complex tile choice with several different colors and they arranged them for the best possible look.  We made a few changes along the way and they managed all of them.   They filled the pool with water on day 35, and we were swimming before the fall weather arrived!  The landscaping around the pool, as well as an added sidewalk from the driveway to the pool, gave it a great finishing touch.  We highly recommend this company to anyone looking to create a backyard paradise!
reviews.author: Craig Singer

reviews.text:
We wanted to jump on here to provide details about our amazing experience with Edge Outdoor Designs!  They built our pool in just 46 days which is a phenomenal timeline.  As wonderful as the speed of the build was - even better was the detail, quality, and craftsmanship that went into every single piece of this project.  This project included the pool, turf, landscaping and outdoor kitchen.  They truly transformed our yard!

As others have mentioned - a big component of this being a fun and easy project was working with Dustin and Zack.  Dustin was literally on-site every single day.  We received daily status and schedule communications from Dustin and Zack as well.

Also, their detail crew who arrive at the end of the build - left our entire space that had construction dust, disruption, etc- driveway, street, sod, front flowerbeds - better than how they found it!

The quality and beauty of their work is unsurpassed!!  I would give them highest recommendation!
reviews.author: Cindy Daigle

reviews.text: Wanted to give a big thank you to Edge Outdoor Designs for converting our backyard into our dream space. They were incredibly efficient from the planning to permitting to build. Zack and Dustin handled every aspect and every member of their team that worked on this project was incredibly professional. We were always kept in the loop on who would be out working as well as the timeline for each stage of the project.  I couldn’t recommend a better a team and we’re so excited to use the space (a months before we thought it would be done!)
reviews.author: Rettig Deinlein

reviews.text: Edge Outdoor designs has been so awesome to work with! My husband loves to grill and we wanted a covered outdoor kitchen done with an additional area we could do sauna and cold plunge recovery. I also wanted concrete placed for some more play space for my son, while still leaving grass for my dog to roam! Zach and David were so good about getting things scheduled and done in a timely manner. We had a few minor changes that were handled with ease and overall we felt very well taken care of! They were responsive and listened to our desires, needs and concerns on all fronts. We love the modern feel of the space and look forward to many more days and nights enjoying our yard so much more than before! Highly recommend Edge Outdoor designs for your next project ◡̈
reviews.author: Chelsea Capri Johnson

reviews.text: We could not have been more impressed with Edge Outdoor Designs!  They have top notch communication, the best customer service, very timely work (fastest in the market in my opinion), and amazing attention to detail.  Nothing slips through the cracks, every step is done to the highest quality possible.  Would recommend them 10/10!
reviews.author: Kara Deinlein
